verses.text: Ix sb'oanpax jun altar winhaj Bezaleel chi', haton jun b'aj stz'a silab'. T'a te' acacia ix sb'o winh. Lajannhej ix aj yechel schanhil pak'anh, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro junjun pak'anh. Jun metro yet' 25 centímetro ix ajk'e schaanhil.
Ix b'ojipaxk'e chanhe' sch'aak t'a schikintak schanhil, yaman ix aj yet' jun altar chi'. Ix pichchaj te' t'a k'een bronce.
Masanil syamk'ab'il jun altar chi', nab'a bronce ix aji: Haton yet'tal b'aj tz'ik'chajel k'een taanh, k'een pala, k'een niwak uk'ab', k'een tenedor yet' yet'tal te' tzak'ak'.
Ix b'ojipax jun k'een malla nab'a bronce, ix ak'jioch k'een t'a yalanh sti' t'a yool. T'a snanhal jun altar chi' ix och k'een.
Ix b'opax chanhe' argolla nab'a bronce, ix och t'a junjun yesquinail k'een malla chi'. Ix elk'och k'een t'a spatik jun altar chi', ha t'a yol k'een tzek' te' sb'akhlab'il.
Ix b'opax sb'akhlab'il jun altar chi' t'a te' acacia, ix ochpax k'een bronce t'a spatiktak te'.
Ix ekchajek' te' t'a yol k'een argolla ayoch t'a stz'eytak jun altar chi' yik syal sb'akhchaji. Ha jun altar chi', chemte' ix och t'ay, ix kan yolanil t'a yool.
Ha yet' k'een nen nab'a bronce sk'an heb' ix ix ayoch yilumalok sti' k'apak mantiado, a yet' k'een ix sb'o jun niwan palangana winhaj Bezaleel yet' sb'akhnub'al yich.
Ix sb'opax k'apak cortina winhaj Bezaleel yik tz'och smakulok spatiktak amak' t'a skajnub' Dios. Ha t'a stojolal sur, ix och 45 metro k'apak cortina chi', haton ch'al lino b'ayb'il ayoch t'a k'apak.
Ix b'opax 20 yoyal yet' 20 pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce. Haxo t'a schon te' ix em juntzanh k'een k'een nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Ix b'opax k'apak cortina yik stojolal norte, 45 metro k'apak yet' 20 oy yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce yet' k'een ayem t'a schon yoyal nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Ix b'opax k'apak cortina yik stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat k'apak yet' lajunhe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yet' k'een ayem t'a schon yoyal nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Hanhejtona' t'a stojolal b'aj sk'eul k'u, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo sat, ix b'opax k'apak cortina yik tz'och t'ay.
Ha t'a jun pak'anh b'aj tzonh ochi, ay uke' metro k'apak cortina ayochi yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich.
Haxo pax t'a junxo pak'anh, ay pax uke' metro k'apak yet' oxe' yoyal yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich.
Masanil juntzanh k'apak cortina chi', ch'al lino b'ayb'il ayoch t'a k'apak.
Masanil pax sb'akhnub'al yich oy chi', nab'a bronce ix aji. Haxo k'een ayem t'a schon oy chi' nab'a plata yet' yargollail.

Ha k'apak cortina ix och smakulok sti' amak' chi', nanhal sb'alunhil metro sat k'apak, haxo steel k'apak, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro. B'ob'ilpaxoch yelwanub' k'apak, jalb'il t'a anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al yet' pax lino ch'al b'ayb'il. Lajannhej yet' masanil k'apak ayoch t'a amak'.
Ay chanhe' yoyal yet' chanhe' sb'akhnub'al yich nab'a bronce, haxo k'een ayem t'a schon yoyal, nab'a plata yet' yargollail.
Masanil yestacail skajnub' Dios chi' yet' yik k'apak cortina ayoch t'a spatiktak amak', nab'a bronce.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés chi' to sb'o slistail jantak k'een oro, k'een plata yet' k'een bronce ix och t'a skajnub' Jehová, haton b'aj sik'chaj skaxail trato. Ha heb' levita ixb'o'an slistail chi'. Ha winhaj Itamar yuninal winhaj Aarón ix kuchb'an heb'.
Ha winhaj Bezaleel, yuninal winhaj Uri, yixchikin winhaj Hur, yinhtilal Judá ixb'o'an masanil tastak ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés to sb'oi.

Haxo winhaj Aholiab yuninal winhaj Ahisamac, yinhtilal Dan ix kolwaj yet' winhaj Bezaleel chi'. Ha winhaj Aholiab chi' tenum k'een winh, jalum k'apak winh, syalpax sb'oanoch yelwanub' yet' anh ch'al k'ik'mutz'inak winh, anh ch'al yaxmakinak, anh chak ch'al yet' anh lino ch'al te wach'.
Masanil k'een oro ix k'anchaji yik ix b'o skajnub' Dios, t'a ofrendail ix aj smoljiem k'een. Ha k'een oro chi', 21 quintal yet' 95 libraxo k'een, icha yalil k'een echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Haxo k'een plata ix molchajemi, a ix ik'chajk'e waan sb'isul heb' anima, 75 quintal yet' chab'xo arroba k'een, icha yalil k'een echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Masanil heb' winak ix tz'ib'chaji, heb' 20 ab'ilxo sk'inal, 603 mil yet' 550 heb' t'a smasanil. Junjun heb' chi' nanhal siclo plata ix yak' heb', icha yalil k'een echlab' sk'anchaj t'a skajnub' Dios.

Ha k'een plata ix och t'a sb'akhnub'al yich smarcoal yet' sb'akhnub'ok yoyal b'aj tz'och k'apak cortina, 75 quintal k'een t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh k'een plata chi' ix och t'a cien sb'akhnub'al chi', syalelk'ochi 75 libra ix och t'a junjun.
Ha yet' chab'xo arroba plata chi' ix sb'o k'een gancho winhaj Bezaleel ix och t'a te' oy yet' smakul sjolom oy chi' yet' k'een argolla.
Masanil k'een bronce ix ak'chaj ofrendail t'a Jehová, ay am 53 quintal yet' lajunhexo libra k'een.

Ha t'a k'een bronce chi' ix b'o sb'akhnub'al yich yoyal b'aj ix kan sti' mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Dios. Hanhejtona' t'a k'een ix b'o jun altar nab'a bronce yet' pax smallail. Nab'a bronce smasanil syamk'ab'il jun altar chi',
yet' pax sb'akhnub'al yich yoyal smakul spatiktak amak' yet' yestacail oyanoch t'a skajnub' Dios yet' yestacail spatiktak yamak'il kajnub' chi'.
